tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App canvas behind the sidebar and page content: deep glacial water (dark) / frost (light). Text sits on surface, not here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default container: page content area, tables, cards, sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Floating layers: dropdowns, popovers, modals, drawers, toasts. Dark adds a 1px frost highlight (in the shadow tokens); light relies on shadow-md/lg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: table header row, ID chips, kanban column body, PDF preview backdrop.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items, menu items, tertiary and icon buttons.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Pressed state of rows, menu items and neutral buttons; the active nav item.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table rows and kanban cards — a teal-tinted ice (always paired with a checked checkbox or a check icon).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and drawers.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and lists; dividers between toolbar groups.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card, panel, menu and modal outlines; table outer frame; section dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered card outlines, kanban drag outline, dashed upload zone, not-yet-due payment segment.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Resting border of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios and the secondary button. ≥3:1 on surface and background in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, table values, titles. 15:1+ on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: descriptions, column headers, metadata, inactive nav labels. 6.4:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions, timestamps, helper text. 4.5:1+ on surface, surface-hover and surface-selected in both themes.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and values only (exempt from contrast; always paired with a disabled cursor and aria-disabled).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a text-primary fill: tooltips, shortcut chips on inverse fills.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links in body text and table cells; alias of accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: Glacier teal. Primary buttons, checked controls, active tab underline, selection, money-in. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: accent-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of accent-primary controls.

tokens.name: accent-primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of accent-primary controls.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Teal as text or icon: links, active nav icon, selected filter labels. 5.1:1+ on every surface and accent-subtle.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Teal ice behind accent-text: active filter chips, selected options, drop targets.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-primary fills: deep-water ink on bright teal (8.1:1) in dark, white on deep teal (4.9:1) in light.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline (2px solid, 2px offset). 5.1:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Glacier blue. Time and schedule: milestones, project progress, calendar ranges, the current timeline node, chart-2.

tokens.name: accent-secondary-text
tokens.usage: Glacier blue as text or icon: dates in range, milestone names, schedule links. 5.2:1+ on surfaces and accent-secondary-subtle.

tokens.name: accent-secondary-subtle
tokens.usage: Blue ice behind accent-secondary-text: in-range calendar days, milestone chips, info banners.

tokens.name: on-accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on accent-secondary fills (date-range ends, current-day marker).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Fill of the secondary button and neutral segmented controls — a bordered ice-neutral control.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of secondary controls.

tokens.name: secondary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of secondary controls.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Label on secondary fills.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Glacial green. Paid, Won, Completed, Active. Text/icon on surface or status-success-subtle; always with a label or check icon.

tokens.name: status-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Due soon, Partially paid, At risk, High priority. Text/icon on surface or status-warning-subtle; always with a label or clock/alert icon.

tokens.name: status-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, Failed, Lost, Urgent, validation errors. Text/icon on surface or status-danger-subtle; always with a label or alert icon.

tokens.name: status-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges, error banners and the destructive confirm area.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Sent, In review, Scheduled — glacier blue, alias of accent-secondary-text.

tokens.name: status-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and banners.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Draft, Archived, Void, On hold, No priority.

tokens.name: status-neutral-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of neutral badges.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of the destructive button (Delete, Void invoice). White label 4.8:1 dark, 5.6:1 light.

tokens.name: danger-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of the destructive button.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger-solid.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1 (teal): revenue, the primary measure.

tokens.name: chart-1-soft
tokens.usage: Lighter step of chart-1 for plan/expected/forecast beside actuals (e.g. Revenue vs Expected). Same entity, told apart by lightness; always with a legend.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series 2 (glacier blue): comparison period, scheduled/forecast.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series 3 (orange): expenses, collected late.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series 4 (violet).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series 5 (yellow). Light step under 3:1 on white: labels or table view required.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Series 6 (magenta). Light step under 3:1: labels required. Past 6 series fold into Other.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines (1px, horizontal only).

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Baseline / zero axis line.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of progress bars, meters and budget gauges.

tokens.name: doc-paper
tokens.usage: Quotation/invoice page background in both app themes.

tokens.name: doc-ink
tokens.usage: Document body text and totals, on doc-paper.

tokens.name: doc-muted
tokens.usage: Document secondary text (addresses, terms), on doc-paper. 7.4:1.

tokens.name: doc-faint
tokens.usage: Document column headers and section labels, on doc-paper. 5.2:1.

tokens.name: doc-accent
tokens.usage: The 3px glacier-teal rule across the top of every document and the document-type title. 4.9:1.

tokens.name: doc-rule
tokens.usage: Document section dividers.

tokens.name: doc-rule-strong
tokens.usage: Line-item header underline.

tokens.name: doc-rule-subtle
tokens.usage: Line-item row dividers.

tokens.name: doc-fill
tokens.usage: Amount-due highlight band on the document (teal-tinted frost).

tokens.name: doc-paid
tokens.usage: PAID stamp on doc-paper (5.6:1).

tokens.name: doc-overdue
tokens.usage: OVERDUE stamp on doc-paper (5.6:1).

tokens.name: tint-orange-text
tokens.usage: Text/icon on tint-orange (5.4:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: tint-orange
tokens.usage: Orange tint: stage headers (Proposal sent), icon tiles for time-sensitive items.

tokens.name: tint-violet-text
tokens.usage: Text/icon on tint-violet (5.9:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: tint-violet
tokens.usage: Violet tint: stage headers (Demo requested), icon tiles for meetings.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist (Google Fonts) with tabular figures on every numeric style. Compact scale: the largest in-app heading is 20px.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page (greeting on the dashboard, record name elsewhere). Never larger in the app shell.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Section titles inside a page, drawer and modal titles.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card, panel and chart-container titles; kanban column titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Kickoff call confirmed for Thursday; scope document attached.
styles.usage: Default text: form values, paragraphs, notes, activity entries.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body: entity names in rows and cards, button labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Last contacted 3 days ago by email
styles.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, list metadata, menu items, nav items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, filter-chip labels, badge text, small button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Helper text: invoices are numbered automatically.
styles.usage: Helper and validation text, chart axis ticks, footnotes, tooltips.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels and document section labels only; set in uppercase via CSS text-transform.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: All Data styles use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns align.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Every table cell. Rows stay one line; truncate with ellipsis and a title tooltip.

styles.name: table-header
styles.usage: Table column headers (sentence case, text-secondary).

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Monetary values in tables and rows: right-aligned, tabular, currency code before the amount, 2 decimals.

styles.name: money-lg
styles.usage: Document totals (invoice/quotation Total due) and payment summary balances.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: KPI values in metric cards only. Maximum one per card.

styles.name: timestamp
styles.usage: Dates and times in activity feeds, comments, audit lines (text-tertiary).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Document numbers, IDs, keyboard shortcuts, repository and branch names, API keys (masked).

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Arabic for العربية (dir=rtl). Same sizes as Interface; line-height grows ~10% for Arabic ascenders; no letter-spacing or uppercase.

styles.name: page-title-ar
styles.usage: Page title in Arabic.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.sample: تم تأكيد اجتماع الانطلاق يوم الخميس.
styles.usage: Body text in Arabic.

styles.name: label-ar
styles.usage: Labels, badges and table headers in Arabic.

groups.name: Document
groups.note: For quotation/invoice layouts rendered at A4 and exported to PDF.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Document type title at the top of a quotation or invoice.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Payment due within 30 days of issue.
styles.usage: Line items, addresses and terms inside the A4 document (11px prints at ~8pt-equivalent legibility on A4).

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Use only these steps; component paddings below reference them.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding; gap between stacked caption and value.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges; gap inside button groups.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and nav items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gap between controls in a toolbar; badge horizontal padding; menu item padding-x.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding-x; input padding-x; gap between form fields in a row; card gap in kanban.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; modal body padding-x; vertical gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Drawer padding-x; gap between dashboard grid cells at 1366.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding-x at 1920; gap between dashboard grid cells at 1920; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major page regions; empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Document (A4) margin inside the PDF preview at 100%.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large empty states and error pages, top padding.

radius.note: Soft but disciplined: 12px cards, 8px controls. Only avatars, icon tiles, dots and switches are fully round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, progress bar ends, chart bar data-ends, kbd chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, filter chips, tooltips, inline ID chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menus, dropdown items, toasts, kanban cards, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables' outer frame, modals, kanban columns, PDF preview frame.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large feature panels: the sidebar promo card, empty-state hero, onboarding.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, switches, radio buttons, count pills.

shadow.note: Elevation is mostly borders. Floating layers get a cold, deep shadow; in dark the frost hairline (a 1px light inset at the top edge) is the glacier signature on elevated surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at rest (secondary only).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Kanban cards, metric cards, sticky table header when scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, selects, date pickers, popovers, tooltips, toasts, a dragged kanban card.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on rounded controls (buttons, inputs): 2px surface gap, then 2px focus-ring.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-danger
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on an invalid input or the destructive button.

size.note: Control and row heights. Pick one control size per toolbar; never mix.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Inline controls inside table rows and kanban cards; badge-height icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar and filter-bar controls, table pagination, page-header secondary actions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default: form inputs, selects, primary page actions, modal footer buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Global search trigger, auth screens, mobile touch layouts (with 44px hit area).

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table rows in Compact density (lists of 100+ records).

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Default table and task-list row height.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Rows with a two-line cell (name + email); mobile lists.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum pointer target (WCAG 2.5.8). Touch layouts use 44px.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed (icon-only) sidebar; default below 1280px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar with breadcrumbs, global search and user menu.

tokens.name: page-header-height
tokens.usage: Page header (title + actions) under the top bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column on wide screens; tables may opt into full width.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Max width of single-column forms and settings pages.

tokens.name: drawer-sm
tokens.usage: Quick-create drawer (task, payment).

tokens.name: drawer-md
tokens.usage: Record preview drawer (client, lead, task detail).

tokens.name: drawer-lg
tokens.usage: Document drawer (invoice/quotation preview, PDF).

tokens.name: modal-sm
tokens.usage: Confirmation dialogs.

tokens.name: modal-md
tokens.usage: Standard forms in a modal.

tokens.name: modal-lg
tokens.usage: Multi-section forms, line-item editors.

tokens.name: command-palette
tokens.usage: Global search / command palette width.

tokens.name: doc-page
tokens.usage: A4 width at 96dpi for quotation/invoice preview (210mm).

icon.note: Lucide icons, 24px viewBox, stroke 2 (renders ~1.33px at 16px), round caps and joins, stroke = currentColor.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Inside badges and sort arrows.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inside control-sm buttons, inline with body-sm and table text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default: buttons, inputs, nav items, menu items.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty-state supporting icons inside a 40px tile, toasts.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Empty-state and error-state primary icons.

breakpoint.note: Desktop-first; min-width queries. Designs are verified at 1366×768 and 1920×1080.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone → small tablet: tables become stacked cards; drawers go full-screen.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet portrait: sidebar becomes an off-canvas sheet.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Tablet landscape / small laptop: collapsed sidebar, 2-column dashboard.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Laptop (1366): expanded sidebar allowed, 3-column dashboard, 4 KPI cards.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Full HD (1920): 4-column dashboard grid, side panels stay docked.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and page header.

tokens.name: z-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and top bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, date pickers, popovers.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawers and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals, confirmation dialogs, command palette.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips (above everything).
